_comment: GitHub #189. The FROZEN set of GTEST_SKIP sites gated on the gitignored
external corpus under test_PDFs/. These oracles do not execute on a clean
checkout -- including every CI run, since actions/checkout runs
`git clean -ffdx` -- and a skip counts as green in the summary line, in the
JUnit XML, and to every gate that reads either.
This file is a RATCHET, not a permission slip. tools/gate/
check_external_corpus_skips.py fails when a site appears that is not listed
here, and equally when an entry here names a file with no such site left, so
the list can neither grow quietly nor outlive what it excuses.
DO NOT add an entry to make a red check green. The committed alternative is
tests/fixtures/realworld/arxiv_bert.pdf, pinned in the CMake fixture floor,
whose absence is a CONFIGURE-time failure rather than a silent skip. Adding
a new oracle to this list is a decision to let it read green without running;
say why that is the better trade, or use a committed fixture instead.

accepted.why: Pins two words of column-major reading order against a real 2-column document. The PROPERTY is not left unasserted on a clean checkout: LayoutExtraction/ExtractionLayoutRealworld's arxiv_bert.pdf oracle (GitHub #27) asserts multi-column reading order unconditionally from a committed fixture. This site adds a second, real-world-document witness where the corpus is available. Not converted because there is no licence-clean 2-column real capture to replace multicolumn.pdf with, and generating one would test the generator's idea of two columns rather than a document in the wild.

The stronger form of the same property -- a COMPLETE partition of every extracted line by column, rather than two pinned words. Same fixture, same reasoning, same unconditional arxiv_bert.pdf backstop for the base property.
